glossary.definition: (H) As used in this section, "peace officer" has the same meaning as in section 2935.01 of the Revised Code and also includes a special agent of the bureau of criminal identification and investigation.
glossary.source_title: Section 3719.141 - Peace officer may sell controlled substance in performance of official duties.
